budgets: Web retrieval source charge conservatively reserved within author22MB; no data/model/native network action.
copyright: Links and short original summaries only; no external source bodies are copied into runtime.

official_sources.supports: All states require --all; --no-trunc retains complete identifiers. Explicit custom formatting can select ID, Names and a named Label.
Volume listing covers known volumes; name and a named label are format fields. Multiple label filters are AND, so no presumed OR batching.
Go templates provide JSON encoding; this is not proof of daemon inventory completeness.
ID is complete without truncation. Names joins slash-stripped names; named Label returns the selected value or empty string.
All and Limit flow to ContainerList; default last is -1, while latest would impose one. Custom output walks returned summaries.
Name and selected Label derive from each volume; no extra projection data is necessary.
Calls VolumeList and formats Volumes; does not check Warnings. This disqualifies exit0 CLI listing alone as complete-volume evidence.
List response includes both Volumes and Warnings; selected API reader must require empty/no warnings, not silently discard them.
Official Engine API schema basis; implementation must use exact version-qualified GET container-list and volume-list contracts.

qualification: Documentation supports source design, not installed CLI/daemon compatibility. Exact API version, namespace, socket identity and HTTP behavior require independent qualification.
selected_implementation: Bounded standard-library read-only local Engine API, with minimal retained identity projection and nonempty-warning refusal. No daemon operation has occurred.
